text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While out shopping, I come across a
pop-up
market for products from
Morioka. I'm taking a
cursory look
around, when...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Welcome t'the Trav'lin Morioka Fest'val!
Come
take a look!

text_block_list.name: Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
S'right! We're here t'introduce Morioka's

traditions 'n' fest'vities. You could call
this shop
Moriokan "pee ar"!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of Moriokan fest'vals, don't
forget 'bout
the sansa odori!
Sakkora! ♪
Choiw—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oof! S-s-s-so sorry! I didn't s—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're a train'r from Tracen, aren't
you!
Terribly sorry for bump'n into you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I-it is! It's called the sansa odori. It's a
tradition'l
dance acc'mpanied by taiko
drums.
choice_data_list: That looked like a fun dance.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's easy to learn, so folks of all ages
dance it all
th'time at school field days
'n' local events 'n'
such.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
People even dance down th'street
during festivals
like a p'rade. There's
even a contest every year
t'see who
boogies it th'best!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There's plenty of other chain dances and
such as
well that anyone can join! It's
more fun than a
barr'l of monkeys!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Just talking about it really takes me
back...
Ev'ryone's hearts united as one...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... You can say that again! I love it
like
peanut butt'r loves jelly!
choice_data_list: You really love the Sansa dance, don't you?
You really love the Sansa dance, huh?

text_block_list.name: Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, you haven't changed a whit...
Thinking
that, I can't help but feel bad...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Well... Take a look around. At the rate
business is
goin' t'day, I might hafta
throw in the towel...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
N-now that you mention it, there haven't
been
any custom'rs.

text_block_list.name: Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Guess we got noth'ng that stands out
t'these big
city folk. And I wanted to
bring good news back
to all th'folks
back home who helped with th'prep
and
what have ya...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
What a cryin' shame! There's so much
good stuff
here! If they'd only just take a
look...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Let me try talk'n to people!
I'll draw in
custom'rs somehow!

text_block_list.name: Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Yukino...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ev'ryone's worked so hard, I wanna help
out too!

text_block_list.name: Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you kindly. You've always been
such a
peach. I don't want you to push
yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Er... Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I-I'm fine, thanks! I'm not givin' up.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There's gotta be a good way. Hm...
Hmmmmm...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin racks her brain for ideas all
the way
back to her dorm.
